decisions.reason: The candidate already distinguishes the uploadable pages version from a spread-preview version; restricting this particular preview copy does not change its spread, format, or page-parity rules.
The copy-specific upload restriction does not change the selected Heyzine platform, white-label workflow, account ownership, or the client's upload responsibility.
The required digital flipbook PDF remains a deliverable; the source only excludes one preview copy from Heyzine upload.
The preview-copy upload restriction does not alter article-ending white-space correction, filler-image selection, or image placement.
The source does not change the supplied content, magazine assembly behavior, or Flat Plan used for the issue layout.
Selecting which copy may be uploaded to Heyzine does not change the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number basis.
The source does not change the requirement for accurate final article page numbers on the cover.
The Heyzine upload restriction is unrelated to the Dorian Vale article's color restriction or the reservation of red for the cover.
The source does not alter the issue's inaugural-edition status or November date label.
The copy-specific upload restriction does not affect inclusion or placement of the supplied tribute page.
The source does not change any image-quality enhancement rule or required treatment of low-resolution assets.
The restriction on uploading a preview copy does not change the claimed contents-page and chapter hyperlink behavior.
